title: Help & feedback
greeting: Hi! Ask me anything about the app. If something is broken, missing or unclear, just tell me: I will prepare a ticket for the team, and you decide whether to send it.
greetingVisitor: Hi! Ask me about AeroStator. Sign-up is free and instant. For a quote, an order or a licence, tell me your name and work e-mail and I will pass them to the team.
failed: Sorry, I could not answer just now. Please try again, or write to support@aerostator.com.

draft.heading: Ticket for the team
draft.ready: I prepared a ticket. Check it, change anything you like, then press Send.
draft.attached: Your conversation and the state of your screen (tab, motor, settings, recent errors) are attached automatically. Passwords and tokens are never included.
draft.sent: Sent. The team has your ticket {id}. Its status is under My tickets.
draft.sentNoId: Sent. The team has your ticket. Its status is under My tickets.
draft.signIn: Sign in to send this ticket.

tickets.empty: No tickets yet. Tell me about a problem or an idea and I will prepare one.

geminiNotice: Runs on Google Gemini. Google may use help-chat messages to improve its services. Do not enter confidential information.
greetingSpec: I am working on this specification with you: I fill what follows from your answers and from data, ask only for what is still missing, and submit it when you say so.
clearTip: Clears this conversation from your view; it is kept for service improvement under our Privacy Policy.
fillTip: On: the values I am sure of go straight into the form, each with its basis and an Undo. Off: I only propose cards you apply yourself.

handoff.signUp: Sign up and create the specification with these values
handoff.create: Create the specification with these values
